question_stem:
A liquid of density ρ fills a container to a depth h, as shown in Fig. 2.1.
The base of the container has area A.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Derive, from the definitions of pressure and density, the equation $p = \rho gh$
where p is the pressure exerted by the liquid on the base of the container and g is the acceleration of free fall.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text:
State 1.
the names of the three forces acting on the sphere, 2.
a word equation that relates the magnitudes of these forces.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: State and explain the changes in energy that occur as the sphere falls.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text: state the value of atmospheric pressure, $\text{atmospheric pressure} = Pa$

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text:
determine the density of liquid M.
density = $kg m ^{3} $
